questions.prompt: Which Roman general was defeated at the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest?
questions.fact: Rome lost three legions and effectively abandoned any attempt to hold territory east of the Rhine.

questions.prompt: What is the term for an inherited characteristic that improves survival?
questions.fact: It is always relative to an environment, so the same trait can be an advantage in one place and a liability elsewhere.

questions.prompt: Which country invented the sport of volleyball?
questions.fact: It was designed in 1895 as a gentler alternative to basketball for older members of a gym.

questions.prompt: Which television series features the Bluth family?
questions.fact: It was cancelled after three seasons and revived years later by a streaming service.

questions.prompt: Which country's capital is Wellington rather than its largest city?
questions.fact: Canberra, Wellington and Ottawa are all smaller than their countries' largest cities, all for similar political reasons.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Cold Comfort Farm?
questions.fact: It parodies rural melodrama so precisely that it helped end the genre it was mocking.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the LLVM compiler infrastructure?
questions.fact: It began as a research project in Illinois and now underpins compilers for a long list of languages.
